description: Valtuutus is a high-performance Relationship-Based Access Control (ReBAC) authorization library for .NET inspired by Google Zanzibar, for fine-grained permissions in ASP.NET Core and .NET applications.
releaseNotes:
This release makes every tokenless Check a single database round trip on Postgres and SQL Server, cuts Postgres allocations across Check and both lookup engines, fixes hangs and stack overflows on recursive or cyclic data, removes the legacy V1 check engine, and clears all known-vulnerable dependencies.

## Breaking changes
* V1 check engine removed (#302). CheckEngine and AddValtuutusCheckV1() are gone; the plan/executor engine (the default since v1.4.0) is the only check engine. Remove any AddValtuutusCheckV1() call.
* IDataReaderProvider slimmed down (#302). GetAttribute, HasAnyOfDirectRelations and HasAnyOfAttributes were removed; custom providers can delete them.

## Performance
* One round trip per tokenless Check on Postgres and SQL Server (#300), was 2 to 3. Check latency -6% to -48%, allocations -7% to -41%.
* Postgres positional parameters (#303). Allocations up to -54% on Check and -4% to -27% on lookups; lookup latency -2% to -16%.

## Fixes
* Self-referencing usersets no longer overflow the stack when the schema is parsed; LookupSubject and LookupEntity no longer recurse forever on membership cycles; Check no longer deadlocks on recursive permissions over cyclic data (#301).

## Security and maintenance
* Valtuutus.Data.SqlServer references a patched System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs (8.0.2 on net8, 9.0.21 on net9 and later) (#306). No known-vulnerable dependencies remain.

## What's Changed
* perf(check): one round trip per tokenless Check on Postgres/SqlServer by @yanpitangui in https://github.com/valtuutus/valtuutus/pull/300
* fix: recursive usersets and permissions over cyclic data by @yanpitangui in https://github.com/valtuutus/valtuutus/pull/301
* chore: remove the V1 CheckEngine by @yanpitangui in https://github.com/valtuutus/valtuutus/pull/302
* perf(postgres): bind catalog queries with positional parameters by @yanpitangui in https://github.com/valtuutus/valtuutus/pull/303
* chore: fix vulnerable dependencies and build warnings by @yanpitangui in https://github.com/valtuutus/valtuutus/pull/306

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/valtuutus/valtuutus/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0
